column1: What CSS filter function converts visual element colors to monochrome shades?
column2: filter: grayscale(percentage) (e.g. filter: grayscale(100%)).

column1: What CSS filter function controls element transparency alongside or independent of opacity property?
column2: filter: opacity(percentage) (e.g. filter: opacity(0.75)).

column1: Why does CSS filter execute on the GPU Compositing layer rather than triggering Layout/Reflow?
column2: Filter functions operate as pixel shader post-processing passes during the paint/composite stage without altering geometric dimensions.

column1: What media query detects if the primary pointer device supports true hovering (like a mouse)?
column2: @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)

column1: What problem occurs on touchscreen devices when hover micro-interactions are not guarded by fine pointer media queries?
column2: Tapping an element triggers sticky hover states where hover pseudo-classes remain permanently active until tapping elsewhere.

column1: What media query explicitly matches touchscreens, styluses, and mobile devices without cursor hover?
column2: @media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse)

column1: What HTML5 semantic element is specifically designed to contain contact information for an author or corporate entity?
column2: The <address> element.

column1: What is the default typographical style applied by browsers to the <address> element?
column2: font-style: italic (reset in modern CSS with font-style: normal).

column1: Why should general physical locations or street addresses unrelated to contact channels not be wrapped in <address>?
column2: The HTML5 specification restricts <address> specifically to contact information for the nearest <article> or <body> ancestor.

column1: What HTML5 attribute is required when multiple <nav> elements exist on the same page?
column2: aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Footer Navigation") to distinguish landmark purpose for screen readers.

column1: What is the minimum recommended touch target size under WCAG 2.1/2.2 Success Criterion 2.5.5 / 2.5.8?
column2: 48px by 48px (or 24px minimum with 48px target spacing).

column1: What CSS technique guarantees an inline-flex link meets the 48px touch target standard without inflating text font size?
column2: Setting min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; on the anchor element.

column1: What CSS pseudo-class targets focus only when initiated via keyboard navigation or assistive technology?
column2: :focus-visible (preventing unwanted focus rings on standard mouse clicks).

column1: What CSS property controls the distance between an outline border and the element's edge?
column2: outline-offset (e.g. outline-offset: 3px).

column1: Why is outline-offset preferred over border or padding changes for focus indicators?
column2: Outlines and outline offsets do not alter the CSS Box Model geometry and cause zero Layout/Reflow recalculations.

column1: What media query allows developers to honor user OS preferences for minimized animations and transitions?
column2: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)

column1: What is the CSS rule to completely disable transitions across animated child elements under reduced motion?
column2: transition: none !important;

column1: What CSS Grid column track expression creates responsive columns that wrap dynamically without hardcoded media queries?
column2: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min_width, 1fr));

column1: What is the key difference between auto-fit and auto-fill in CSS Grid when fewer items exist than available tracks?
column2: auto-fit collapses empty tracks to 0px allowing existing items to stretch, whereas auto-fill preserves empty track slots.

column1: What attributes must always accompany target="_blank" on external hyperlinks for security and performance?
column2: rel="noopener noreferrer" (prevents window.opener exploitation and process thread blocking).

column1: What accessibility attribute hides decorative vector SVGs from screen reader accessibility trees?
column2: aria-hidden="true"

column1: Why should telephone numbers in web documents use the tel: URL scheme?
column2: tel:+2348106246748 allows mobile operating systems and VoIP applications to initiate one-tap direct dialing.

column1: Why should email addresses in web documents use the mailto: URL scheme?
column2: mailto:mjrgdesigns@gmail.com triggers the user's default OS email client with the recipient pre-populated.

column1: What is the minimum WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratio required for standard body text against its background?
column2: 4.5:1 (or 3:1 for large text >= 24px or bold >= 18.66px).

column1: What computed contrast ratio is required for WCAG AAA enhanced compliance?
column2: 7:1 for normal text (or 4.5:1 for large text).
